subject.title: fix(slack): mark connected status degraded without bot identity

question: Have all Slack bot, user, and app-level tokens pasted during this PR's proof process been revoked and replaced before merge?
rationale: Repository review can validate the patch but cannot verify revocation of credentials controlled by the external Slack workspace.

options.title: Confirm rotation, then merge
options.body: Require the workspace operator to confirm that every exposed xoxb, xoxp, and xapp token was revoked and replaced before proceeding.

options.title: Keep the PR blocked
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until credential ownership or rotation can be conclusively established.

recommendation.title: Confirm rotation, then merge
recommendation.body: Require the workspace operator to confirm that every exposed xoxb, xoxp, and xapp token was revoked and replaced before proceeding.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack lifecycle history makes this person the best available routing candidate for the merge and security confirmation.
